note: Adapted from the new-species description in Krishna & Araujo 1968 (Bulletin of the American Museum of Natural History 138), originally in English; the soldier description is complete, but the source package contains only table 17 (queen measurements) and no soldier measurement table, so no measurements are given for the soldier. The queen description in the text precedes table 17 and is truncated, so only the measurements are usable; the last row of table 17, "forewing bud width", is truncated and has not been given. From line 240 of the source package the text belongs to the next species, Neocapritermes utiariti, and was not used.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier is closest to N. braziliensis in the long, slender mandibles and the upcurved apex of the left mandible; the latter is smaller in all measurements, has 15-segmented antennae (16 in this species), a swollen and dark antennal segment 3, and the left anterior margin of the labrum oblique and concave. Queen compared with N. angusticeps: the latter has the pronotum densely covered with long hairs, a narrower head, larger compound eyes, the ocelli closer to the compound eyes, a smaller frontal plate that is not convex in profile, and a shorter antennal segment 3; N. bodkini is larger in all measurements and N. braziliensis smaller in all of them; N. opacus has a wider head and pronotum, smaller ocelli situated farther from the compound eyes.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head very pale yellowish brown; the anterior margin of the head, the antennal segments, the base of the mandibles and the postmentum darker; labrum pale yellow; mandibles glossy black; pronotum and legs pale grass yellow; mesonotum, metanotum and abdomen dirty white. Head with numerous short, fine, erect setae of uniform size, interspersed with a few longer ones, more numerous distally; labrum with a row of longer median setae; postmental hairs of the same type, the 2 anterior ones longer; thoracic tergites with very few hairs of two sizes, more numerous at the outer corners; legs moderately haired; cervical sclerites glabrous; fore coxa with a row of setae of two sizes along the anterior ridge; abdomen almost glabrous. Head rectangular, elongate, about 1.7× as long as wide, the sides straight and slightly narrowing anteriorly, with an almost invisible swelling near the anterolateral corners; posterolateral corners rounded, passing into a straight posterior margin. In profile the upper margin of the head is straight, the distal third slightly inclined forward, the posterior margin rounded; the underside of the head capsule broadly arcuate, straight at the level of the postmentum; the postclypeal region slightly twisted, the left side a little higher; fontanelle very small, in a very shallow depression. Antennae as long as the mandibles, 16-segmented, segment 3 the shortest, segments 4 to 10 gradually longer, segments 11 to 15 gradually shorter, segment 16 oblong and as long as the preceding segment. Labrum long, constricted at the middle, the left margin more deeply concave, the anterolateral corners rounded, with a mound-like process at the middle. Mandibles long and slender, slightly shorter than the head; the base of the left mandible broad, moderately curved, tapering towards an expanded apex that ends in an upcurved hook; the right mandible almost straight, very gradually tapering to a point, with a broad groove on the underside at the base. The sides of the postmentum very gradually narrowing posteriorly and widening again near the base, with narrow lateral processes at the apex, the anterior and posterior margins straight. Pronotum 0.66× the head width, slightly concave in profile, the posterior lobe broadly semicircular, the posterior margin straight. Mesonotum flat, the sides rounded. Metanotum slightly wider than the posterior lobe of the pronotum, the posterior margin broadly concave. Middle tibia without spines.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Queen (morphotype) measurements (mm): head capsule lateral length 1.22; head width (including compound eyes) 1.73; maximum diameter of the compound eye 0.51; distance from the lower edge of the compound eye 0.10; ocellus long diameter 0.23, short diameter 0.18; distance from the ocellus to the compound eye 0.08; frontal plate long diameter 0.17; pronotum maximum length 0.97, median length 0.89, maximum width 1.48; forewing bud length 1.02.
